text:
Maria: hey team, PR #9721 is blocking CI — integration-payments job keeps timing out on `test_refund_flow`. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9721 :eyes:
Alex: on it, give me a minute to pull logs
Devops-Bot: Buildkite build #54822 failed — logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood/builds/54822 (integration-payments timed out)
Liam: I can try to repro locally. what command should I run to hit the failure?
Maria: `pytest tests/integration/test_payments.py::test_refund_flow -q` — it hangs waiting on the bank simulator call, then TimeoutError
Sara: we merged a change to the bank simulator client in #9680 last week, maybe timing semantics changed
Jen: quick thought — adding retries in the test fixture might hide a real issue though
Paul: if it's blocking a release we can temporary xfail, but prefer a quick patch to the mock if possible
Alex: @Paul let's avoid xfail for now. @Liam can you run with `BANK_SIM_DELAY=0.2` and paste the last 30s of logs?
Liam: running now, tail of the failing run:
```
...Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/src/tests/integration/test_payments.py", line 72, in test_refund_flow
    resp = client.refund(txn_id)
TimeoutError: bank simulator didn't respond within 30s
```
Maria: thanks — my change adjusted header ordering and may have affected the mock handshake timing. I'm going to push a tiny test fix to make the mock emulate the new header sequence and increase the mock timeout slightly
Sara: that sounds reasonable. If you push a short patch, I can eyeball it quickly
Alex: ping me with the diff; I can review and approve fast if it's small
Maria: pushed at 1862010234 — added a small backoff in the test fixture and updated the mock handshake to accept the new header order: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9721/files
Devops-Bot: Buildkite: manual re-run triggered for build #54823 by @Maria
Liam: rerun shows unit tests passing again but integration still flaky — same assertion fails intermittently (about 1 in 6 runs)
Paul: if it continues to be intermittent I'll bisect between #9680 and #9721 later today to identify the regression commit
Sara: question for release: is this blocking the payments hotfix rollout? What's priority?
Maria: this is the payments hotfix, high priority. If Alex approves and SRE signs off on a rollback plan, we should merge once CI is green or allow an admin-merge with follow-up monitoring
Alex: I reviewed and left two tiny nits, otherwise LGTM. Approving after CI green. @Eng-SRE can you confirm rollback/monitoring plan?
Eng-SRE: SRE ok — we have a rollback play and can set a short-term alert on payments error rate > 0.5%. We'll watch the release window closely
Maria: thanks all — I'll hold for final green then merge. Will follow up if flakes persist and coordinate bisecting if needed
Alex: thanks, and @Liam @Paul appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
